rule.integerAtLeast: a whole number of at least {min}
rule.list: a list in which each item is {item}
rule.httpsOrigin: an HTTPS address with no path, such as `https://owner.example.ts.net`
rule.timeZone: an IANA time zone such as Asia/Shanghai
rule.chain: a chain id such as eip155:56
rule.decimal: a decimal number written as text, such as "0.002"
rule.usd: US dollars written as text, such as "100" or "0.25", with at most six decimals
rule.path: an absolute path, or one that starts with ~/
rule.keychainName: a keychain entry name of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores
rule.credentialName: a credential name of capital letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter
